entities.name: Chester
entities.description: A mule owned by Zagorka on Otaria, her trusted friend and companion, enlarged by Krosa's mutating power.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: A woman living on Otaria who owned Chester and died during the Rebirth of Karona.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Land on Dominaria where Zagorka lived.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: City that needed mule drivers and charged an entrance fee.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Resuscitated Chester with his newfound powers.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: Land whose mutating power enlarged Chester.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: Structure for which Zagorka hauled materials.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Befriended Zagorka; spawned the nightmare death wurms.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: A war in which Zagorka rode Chester.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: Companion who galloped south with Chester and Zagorka.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: Ancient city whose crumbled entrance Zagorka found and named Sanctum.

entities.name: Corian Escarpment
entities.description: Escarpment along which they galloped south.

entities.name: Glyphs
entities.description: Structures that began to rise in Averru and menace victims.

events.summary: A guard at Aphetto gives Chester a mortal wound as payment when Zagorka cannot afford the entrance fee.
events.quote: the guard gave Chester a mortal wound as payment

events.summary: Kamahl resuscitates Chester, and Krosa's mutating power makes him far larger and stronger.
events.quote: Kamahl resuscitated Chester back to life with his newfound powers

events.summary: Zagorka rides Chester in the Nightmare War, and he saves her life escaping Phage's death wurms.
events.quote: he saved her life when they escaped the terrible nightmare death wurms that were spawned by Phage

events.summary: Chester, Zagorka and Stonebrow find the entrance to Averru, which Zagorka names Sanctum.
events.quote: eventually stumbled over the crumbled entrance to the city of Averru

events.summary: When the Glyphs rise, Chester helps victims escape by kicking down walls and destroying Glyphs; he is separated from Zagorka, who is trapped and dies.
events.quote: Zagorka perished during the Rebirth of Karona

relations.quote: He was her trusted friend and companion.

relations.note: Befriended her at the Grand Coliseum.

relations.quote: Kamahl resuscitated Chester back to life
